text:
13 years and my hebrew still crap. My life is at home with my cats and hubby and when I do go out, it is to teach English 🤣 so I dont have time to really mingle for language or the power. When I was younger, every single Israeli just wanted to speak in English with me...and then there was corona when we couldn't go anywhere and then wars....many factors that hinder language acquisition.
Not everyone acquires languages. Every time i went to misrad hapnim my level was little to none and never affected my case.
Who is someone to judge you for not knowing a language?!
